scientific_integrity: The all-size conclusions are based on a finite-poset proof; computation is supplementary. Originality is based on accessible literature and claim-implication comparisons, without an exhaustive priority guarantee. The previously known nine-element example is credited.
scientific_limitations: Finite Heyting algebras and fixed antecedents only; no infinite-algebra theorem or assertion of uniqueness of the seven-element intrinsic nondistributive lattice. Independent scientific audit not performed.
title: Distributivity of finite Heyting materializers: a minimal-support criterion and a sharp nine-element boundary
